end.summary:
Practised copying a shape on a dot grid by counting gaps along each side.
Myra identified a side as 3 units by 2 units but often counted dots instead of gaps.
After a break, they used a finger to count three gaps between four dots.
The final route used left 3 gaps and down 2 gaps, but the starting point and corner shape were not completed; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting the spaces between dots so Myra could copy a shape by units rather than by counting dots. Myra first mixed up dots and gaps, then showed one gap and counted three gaps with a finger; the mix-up was only partly corrected by the end. At home, draw a short line between four dots and ask Myra to point to the three gaps before copying it.
